proposition: SourceCurrentness permits candidate action only for CandidateCurrent, and that state is disjoint from every base-side state.
non_claims: This claim does not establish that source-currentness inputs were collected from the correct repository or merge group.
This claim does not establish correctness of every consumer of SourceCurrentness.
domain: Every SourceCurrentness constructor enumerated by the maintained CURRENTNESS proof-domain constant.
assumptions: The symbolic index is constrained below CURRENTNESS.len().
trust_dependencies: CBMC solver execution and result reporting
the pinned Rust verifier toolchain and target configuration
negative_controls: Mutation control: permit candidate action for a base-side or unresolved currentness state.
result_satisfaction: One current verified row for the registered subject with both disjoint-state covers satisfied.
currentness_inputs: provider, solver and Rust toolchain identity
runner generation and effective verifier configuration
actual admitted merge-group and ordered member heads
transition_policy: base_and_head_remain_protected_until_an_explicit_generation-bumped replacement or recorded retirement is accepted
